snippet.title: Chess Arena-象棋竞技场 // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/712880/Chess_Arena/

这是一款下棋和动作游戏结合的创意作品，传统的象棋棋子们将化身为真正的战士，在棋盘上决斗。
- - - 
This is a creative work that combines chess and action games. Traditional chess pieces will be transformed into real warriors and duel on the chessboard.

Developed by
HideChara
